answer: A inlet of per-task receipts records who did what, and the jade of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Written in a plain sentences, numbers cited inline register, it stays short. Reaching the haven of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The design leans on receipt hashes checked against public logs before trust.
